notes: Most consequential finding in this range. The Introduction reports A.8-A.9 faithfully as a conditional and says next that H-scramble fails for a definite configuration with an aligned bipartition. It does not say that this is the setting in which A.8 counts its 'initial conditions'. GR's own text attributes the failing setting only to 'Theorem A.7's proof' (GR.md:835), while A.8's statement and proof count configurations of Σ_E (GR.md:837-841). BHb C6(a) and its independent review (REVIEW.md:69-76: 'H-scramble cannot hold for any φ, and A.8's conclusion fails for every initial configuration … Recommend citing A.8's counting over configurations as the textual anchor') make the point exactly. So the conditional has no instance where its fraction is counted. It needs an initial superposition or a non-aligned factorization that GR does not specify, and even then BHb C2 caps the entanglement at the initial basis entropy H(p_0), so the state must spread over about e^{S_Page} configurations. 'Exponentially negligible fraction of initial conditions' therefore reads stronger than the theorem's content. Severity: moderate. The status line (I-244) is right, but this sentence invites a non-vacuous reading.
